name: AssetListItem
intent: Selectable row for a captured asset — thumbnail with an overlay slot, clamped title and subtitle, and a meta line.
when: Listing camera feeds, drone captures, timelapses or any thumbnailed record
A list selection drives a map or detail panel beside it
whenNot: Rows with no media -> use Item or a DataTable row
A rich work record with status and assignees -> use WorkItemCard

chooseOver.component: A hand-built Card with an img and a badge row
chooseOver.because: One template held three copies of this shell differing only in the thumbnail overlay and the meta line; both are slots here.

lineage.authoredBy: Extracted from the three duplicated list items in core-org-reality-capture (2026-08-25)

extracted: 80x56 thumbnail well with an overlay layer

notes: The three copies also used template-literal classNames; the component uses cn, matching the rest of the library.
